The backend for LWJGL 3: its context requests, its OpenGL bindings and its snapshot backend with the OpenGL profiles of the tests.
Learn: [LWJGL 3 backend](/build/backends/lwjgl3/).

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`GlContextRequest`](/reference/lwjgl3/glcontextrequest/) | enum | The OpenGL context that a GLFW window asks for, set as window hints before the window exists. |
| [`Lwjgl3Backend`](/reference/lwjgl3/lwjgl3backend/) | class | The backend for LWJGL 3, which draws with OpenGL into a GLFW window and plays sound with the OpenAL of LWJGL 3. |
| [`Lwjgl3CoreGlFrameBufferBinding`](/reference/lwjgl3/lwjgl3coreglframebufferbinding/) | class | The LWJGL 3 framebuffer binding that calls the core framebuffer functions of OpenGL 3.0 and `GL_ARB_framebuffer_object`. |
| [`Lwjgl3ExtGlFrameBufferBinding`](/reference/lwjgl3/lwjgl3extglframebufferbinding/) | class | The LWJGL 3 framebuffer binding that calls the functions of `GL_EXT_framebuffer_object`. |
| [`Lwjgl3GlBinding`](/reference/lwjgl3/lwjgl3glbinding/) | class | The OpenGL binding of LWJGL 3, which calls the core classes `GL11C` to `GL33C`. |
| [`Lwjgl3SnapshotBackend`](/reference/lwjgl3/lwjgl3snapshotbackend/) | class | The snapshot backend of LWJGL 3, which renders in a hidden GLFW window with the OpenGL profile of the test run. |
| [`ProfileGlBinding`](/reference/lwjgl3/profileglbinding/) | class | Wraps an OpenGL binding so that the context looks like a snapshot profile: hidden extensions and an older GLSL version. |
| [`SnapshotProfile`](/reference/lwjgl3/snapshotprofile/) | enum | The OpenGL contexts on which the snapshot tests of LWJGL 3 run, each a version, a profile and the extensions it hides. |
